## Outside mathematics

I have been practicing Kendo (剣道, a traditional Japanese martial art, meaning “the way of the sword”) for over 15 years and am currently third dan (三段). I am a member of the [All United States Kendo Federation](https://auskf.info/) (AUSKF). I am also a certified referee for the [International Kendo Federation](https://www.kendo-fik.org/) (FIK).

My sensei (instructor) is Fumihide Itokazu, a member of [Team USA](https://www.teamusakendo.com/) for the 12th and 13th World Kendo Championships. [Here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sai91h-8Y74) is a video from the 13th WKC, when USA defeated Japan in the semifinal (and unfortunately lost to Korea in the final).
